title: Refactor plan-kind catalog needs bounded field projection and pagination
wanted_capability: An isolate-friendly plan-kind catalog API that can return only kind/backend/safety/required_schema/examples for a requested language, with pagination or projection, without hitting MCP response caps or requiring parsing large previews.
fallback_used: Filtered to language=rust and manually reduced the JSON inside exec; unfiltered all-language catalog returned response_too_large.
notes: Observed all-language bbox_refactor_plan_kinds response_too_large at 100862 bytes over an 81920 cap while exploring isolate usage.
resolution_note: Closed as obviated 2026-08-19: the daemon-MCP refactor plan/apply/run surface no longer exists (operator ruling in-session; crates/bbox-mcp-tools registers only agentic-graph tools, and code/java transforms live in bro-harness bindings). Surface retirement is the resolution; no fix to cite.
